help.intro: If Claude gets stuck, shows an error, or a tool does not work, send the session to Victor so he can see exactly what happened.
steps: Export the session: type / then e, and pick Export session (press Tab). It runs right away, saves a .zip of this conversation, and offers Show in folder.
Send the .zip to Victor Ortega on Teams, with one line about what you were doing.
You can also tell Claude "report this issue" and it logs it for the EPLUS team.
